note: The whole-document lookups the browser half still makes outside the modules that own them, one entry per file: what it counts, when those reads happen where that is known, and which of them are debt. A lookup in a refresh pass or a frame callback costs the page's own size on every frame of a long conversation, so the sanctioned readers are the engine host.ts's accessors (cacheFirstMatch caches a match and a miss until the page's structure changes), the engine bus.ts's observeMatches registry, the engine stylesheet.ts's own sheet, and the engine chat-dom.ts's two per-frame answers; every other site is recorded here and the list only shrinks. A read by an element's id is not counted: the browser answers it from its own index rather than by walking the tree, which is how the fold controls reach the body their aria-controls names. scripts/lint.mjs counts the sites the way this file records them: a file whose count rises is refused, a file whose count falls has to be written down again, and an entry whose count reaches zero is taken out.
